findings.title: Canvas wallet issuer contract mismatch
findings.observation: Wallet expected nonce in token response and sent the rejected format request member.
findings.change_or_next_action: Fetch a fresh dedicated nonce and omit format; retain historical report compatibility.
findings.verification: 5 locked Rust tests pass using current contract fixtures; signing boundary uses a local HTTP server.

findings.title: Lifecycle cleanup can affect unrelated fixtures
findings.observation: Broad draft deletion and active-credential cleanup matched shared names/VCT/template.
findings.change_or_next_action: Create and track a unique run template; validate exact organization and current-run transaction ownership before mutation; report pending transactions and uncertain mutation outcomes as incomplete.
findings.verification: 20 lifecycle tests include ownership, failed setup, lost responses, ambiguous IDs, and cleanup failures; no live beta mutation.

findings.title: Lifecycle selects concurrent issuance by recency
findings.observation: Newest matching credential can belong to another run.
findings.change_or_next_action: Correlate public issuance response.id or renewal response.transaction_id to inventory.flow_execution_id; verify renewal predecessor and reject ambiguity.
findings.verification: Current gateway fixture used in issuance regression; 20 lifecycle and 6 provider-switch consumer tests pass.

findings.title: Headless audits bypass served evidence
findings.observation: A HeadlessChrome user agent returned compiled manifests instead of performing HTTP fetches.
findings.change_or_next_action: Use explicit build-only prerender injection; ordinary headless users load served JSON.
findings.verification: Focused UI regressions and production Chrome check confirm served requests, no build marker, visible503 and Retry recovery.

findings.title: Non-public recordings can become playable
findings.observation: YouTube ID alone enabled playback; recording changes could retain consent. Current manifest has no such unlisted recording.
findings.change_or_next_action: Require PUBLIC state and reset consent on recording/publication binding change; preserve consent for chapter navigation.
findings.verification: UI tests and controlled unlisted-manifest/browser frame fixture pass; external streaming is not qualified.

findings.title: Malformed evidence can crash catalog rendering
findings.observation: Missing assertions passed loading and failed at render; invalid latest-available references could be accepted.
findings.change_or_next_action: Validate required assertions and index references before render, preserving recoverable error/retry.
findings.verification: Focused UI regressions and production malformed-manifest browser check pass; complete nested schema hardening remains outside this patch.

findings.title: External driver timeout can wait indefinitely
findings.observation: SIGTERM-ignoring child or inherited pipes delayed completion until test fail-safe.
findings.change_or_next_action: Use owned POSIX group termination, forceful escalation, and bounded drain; preserve timeout diagnostics.
findings.verification: Two real-process regressions improve ~6s fail-safe to ~1.5s for500ms timeout; selected recorder suite49/49; Windows branch not executed.

findings.title: Functional reruns still require secondary recordings
findings.observation: D04/D05/D06 drivers honor RECORD_VIDEO=0 but configs required secondary WebMs as ordinary evidence.
findings.change_or_next_action: Declare only known secondary media as recordingFiles; keep functional JSON mandatory and recorded-run requirements intact.
findings.verification: Actual scenario configuration tests with synthetic drivers pass; source-reviewed driver recording gates; D10/D12 remain open.

findings.title: QR assertions do not decode QR payloads
findings.observation: Loaded images and arbitrary SVG/canvas patterns could pass superficial checks.
findings.change_or_next_action: Decode rendered PNG screenshot with existing ZXing decoder, optionally verify expected payload, store only payload SHA256.
findings.verification: 7 QR regressions and6 actual Chrome render cases pass; original action fails4 regression cases. Framework fix; maintained top-level demo configs do not call this action at baseline.

findings.title: 320px public header overflows viewport
findings.observation: Document measured328px wide at320px; Login right edge~328.3px.
findings.change_or_next_action: Use existing compact language selector and smaller mobile adjacent margin.
findings.verification: Production Chrome widths320,390,768,1440 all fit; fallback fonts used after external font certificate failures.

findings.title: Legacy narrated demo can report false functional success
findings.observation: Missing-controls stub reproduction completed5 scenes and skipped1; required actions are optional/errors swallowed, final business outcomes not asserted, and3 Locator values enter a string-based scrolling helper.
findings.change_or_next_action: Use current console routes, explicit linked mDL prerequisites, dynamic form controls, exact application/applicant/template approval binding, and both issued and CLAIMED final state. This closes false-success reporting; the legacy harness still requires external real wallet redemption.
findings.verification: 10 named local helper tests pass; all six scenes parse in Playwright --list. No full seeded authenticated journey.

findings.title: Legacy Canvas recording ignores required step failures
findings.observation: Several tryShow/tryContinue false results are ignored before media finalization/completed_at.
findings.change_or_next_action: Require nine checkpoints and their relevant UI evidence; preserve failed-run reports and finalization errors; no completion timestamp on failure. Retain explicit legacy sandbox/non-OSS qualification scope and configuration refusal before artifact cleanup.
findings.verification: 18 named local control-flow and failure-finalization tests pass; no real Canvas or authenticated provider workflow.

findings.title: D10 driver cannot honor recording-free environment switch
findings.observation: Arguments always contain --record-video; Python driver uses that flag rather than RECORD_VIDEO.
findings.change_or_next_action: D10 honors RECORD_VIDEO=0 over --record-video, exports the required trace without screenshots/DOM/source snapshots, and records NOT_CAPTURED with no video. Ordinary recordings retain their requirements.
findings.verification: 32 Python release-check/entrypoint tests and the shipped D10 recorder contract cases pass locally; synthetic audit operations, no live beta run.

findings.title: D12 driver requires recordings and retained media
findings.observation: Driver requires RECORD_VIDEO=1 and copies negative-lane videos while recording unconditionally.
findings.change_or_next_action: Recording-free qualification remains unsupported. An explicit configuration reason now rejects before recorder hooks, source binding, maintenance, process setup, or standalone driver artifacts. A reviewed recording-free protected receipt contract is still required.
findings.verification: 30 selected recorder tests and 8 passport evidence/privacy/early-gate tests pass locally. The browser privacy fixture uses synthetic local content. No full D12 execution.

findings.title: Shared employee/passport helper still selects by recency
findings.observation: findCurrentCredential filters template and timestamp then selects newest record; cleanup can use that selected ID.
findings.change_or_next_action: Resolve the public issuance transaction by the exact run-owned application ID; require credential application_id, flow_execution_id, organization, and template agreement. Re-establish every binding before cleanup and reject ambiguous inventories or unconfirmed mutation state.
findings.verification: Offline baseline reproduction selected and revoked a newer credential from another run. The 66 named local helper/consumer/contract/regression tests pass; no live execution.

baseline_reproduction.method: Offline source-loaded doubles; no live HTTP or environment mutations

findings.title: Shared test-wallet reset and revocation profile ownership
findings.observation: receiveCredential calls /api/reset; concurrency boundary is unqualified if demos share a wallet process. Revocation-profile reuse/creation is pre-existing.
findings.change_or_next_action: Isolate wallet process per run and review reset/profile ownership before concurrent shared-fixture execution.
findings.verification: Risk identified from source; no live concurrency claim or repair.

findings.title: Obsolete manifest responses can replace the newly selected release
findings.observation: Aborting a previous loader did not stop its late success or wrapped failure from replacing current route state; previous data could also render before the next effect ran.
findings.change_or_next_action: Bind asynchronous state to the selected release/retry and discard results after cancellation.
findings.verification: Late success and late failure both reproduced before the fix. Focused UI suites pass 17 tests, including the real-router regressions.

findings.title: Chapter seek position carries into a different demo recording
findings.observation: Seeking to 75 seconds and navigating between scenario routes reused the old start position for the next recording.
findings.change_or_next_action: Keep seek state inside the recording detail keyed by release, scenario, revision, video, and publication state. A different recording starts at zero with fresh consent.
findings.verification: Forward and return route navigation reproduced the stale seek before the fix and pass after it. Same-recording chapter seeking still preserves consent.

findings.title: Canvas and provider-switch verification accepts the wrong signed credential type
findings.observation: A legacy substring fallback matched every string when credential_type was absent and accepted unrelated, missing, or misleadingly similar signed VCT values.
findings.change_or_next_action: Require a nonempty expected VCT before consuming an offer and exact equality after signature verification.
findings.verification: The exchange suite passed 20 tests after four baseline failures. Fixtures execute real ES256 verification and holder-key binding with scripted issuer/nonce/credential/DID responses.

findings.title: Demo preflight withdraws pre-existing applications
findings.observation: Shared preflight withdrew all nonterminal applications matching the organization and credential template, without proving they belonged to the current run.
findings.change_or_next_action: Treat an existing application as an explicit conflict; inspect all pages and perform no preflight withdrawals.
findings.verification: Offline baseline reproduction withdrew an existing APPROVED operator application. New conflict and pagination tests confirm no preflight mutations.

baseline_reproduction.method: Offline source-loaded doubles; no live HTTP or environment mutations

findings.title: Shared setup activates a pre-existing draft configuration
findings.observation: A same-name existing DRAFT resource could be validated and activated by a new demo run.
findings.change_or_next_action: Activate only resources created by this run; reject existing drafts and foreign-organization responses while retaining validated active-configuration reuse.
findings.verification: Offline baseline reproduction activated an existing draft while reporting created:false. New tests reject existing drafts and foreign organization responses and preserve active-resource reuse.

baseline_reproduction.method: Offline source-loaded doubles; no live HTTP or environment mutations

findings.title: Application ownership is lost when submission or evidence validation fails
findings.observation: Callers assigned the application ID only after create-and-submit completed. A later submit or passport evidence failure could leave the newly created application outside cleanup; failure reports were not always written.
findings.change_or_next_action: Record the created application immediately with run, applicant, organization, and template ownership; preserve uncertain mutations, release reviewer locks in finally, verify cleanup response state, and write failure reports after cleanup.
findings.verification: Offline baseline reproductions lost the created application ID after submit HTTP 503 and skipped unlock after a lost acquisition response. New consumer tests retain IDs after submit/evidence failure, attempt exact lock release, and retain unconfirmed lock uncertainty.

baseline_reproduction.method: Offline source-loaded doubles; no live HTTP or environment mutations
